composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Create a fox head combining coral fabric and ivory paper pieces. Keep the cheeks broad and the muzzle short, with two coordinated dark eyes. A few visible stitches join the fabric forehead to the paper cheek shapes, but no frame surrounds the head. Render weave and paper fibers selectively. Soft side light separates the materials against a pale blue-gray field. Use mixed fabric-and-paper collage. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
